<p dir="auto"><em>Build multi-agent networks with deterministic routing and rich tooling via MCP.</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/inngest/agent-kit/blob/main/AgentKit-Tracing.png"><img src="/inngest/agent-kit/raw/main/AgentKit-Tracing.png" alt="AgentKit Tracing" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p align="center" dir="auto">
    <a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/overview" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a>
    <span> · </span>
    <a href="https://www.inngest.com/blog?ref=github-agent-kit-readme" rel="nofollow">Blog</a>
    <span> · </span>
    <a href="https://www.inngest.com/discord" rel="nofollow">Community</a>
</p>
<p dir="auto">AgentKit offers more deterministic and flexible routing, works with multiple model providers, embraces MCP (for rich tooling), and supports the unstoppable and growing community of TypeScript AI developers. Combined the Inngest Dev Server to start locally and its orchestration engine, making your Agents fault-tolerant when deployed to the cloud.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Core concepts</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/concepts/agents" rel="nofollow"><strong>Agents</strong></a>: LLM calls that can be combined with prompts, <a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/concepts/tools" rel="nofollow">tools</a>, and <a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/advanced-patterns/mcp" rel="nofollow">MCP</a>.</li>
<li><a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/concepts/networks" rel="nofollow"><strong>Networks</strong></a>: a simple way to get Agents to collaborate with a shared State, including handoff.</li>
<li><a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/concepts/state" rel="nofollow"><strong>State</strong></a>: combines conversation history with a fully typed state machine, used in routing.</li>
<li><a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/concepts/routers" rel="nofollow"><strong>Routers</strong></a>: where the autonomy lives, from code-based to LLM-based (ex: ReAct) orchestration</li>
<li><a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/getting-started/local-development" rel="nofollow"><strong>Tracing</strong></a>: debug and optimize your workflow locally and in the cloud with built-in tracing</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Get started now by <a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/examples/overview" rel="nofollow">cloning our examples</a> or <a href="https://agentkit.inngest.com/overview" rel="nofollow">exploring the documentation</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Get started</h2><a id="user-content-get-started" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Get started" href="#get-started"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-tsx notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npm i @inngest/agent-kit inngest"><pre><span class="pl-s1">npm</span> <span class="pl-s1">i</span> @<span class="pl-s1">inngest</span><span class="pl-c1">/</span><span class="pl-s1">agent</span><span class="pl-c1">-</span><span class="pl-s1">kit</span> <span class="pl-s1">inngest</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Note:</strong> Starting with AgentKit v0.9.0, you need to install <code>inngest</code> as a separate dependency alongside <code>@inngest/agent-kit</code>. This ensures proper runtime compatibility and prevents conflicts when multiple packages depend on different versions of Inngest.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">MCP Agent example</h2><a id="user-content-mcp-agent-example" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: MCP Agent example" href="#mcp-agent-example"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Choose your favorite MCP server on Smithery (or self-host one) to build an AgentKit Agent using MCP as tools. Here is an example using the <a href="https://smithery.ai/server/neon" rel="nofollow">Neon database MCP server</a>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-tsx notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="import {
  anthropic,
  createAgent,
  createNetwork,
  createTool,
} from "@inngest/agent-kit";
import { createServer } from "@inngest/agent-kit/server";
import { createSmitheryUrl } from "@smithery/sdk/config.js";
import { z } from "zod";

const neonServerUrl = createSmitheryUrl(
  "https://server.smithery.ai/neon/mcp?profile=bored-catshark-da8hf&api_key=123123123"
);

const neonAgent = createAgent({
  name: "neon-agent",
  system: `You are a helpful assistant that help manage a Neon account.
  IMPORTANT: Call the 'done' tool when the question is answered.
  `,
  tools: [
    createTool({
      name: "done",
      description: "Call this tool when you are finished with the task.",
      parameters: z.object({
        answer: z.string().describe("Answer to the user's question."),
      }),
      handler: async ({ answer }, { network }) => {
        network?.state.kv.set("answer", answer);
      },
    }),
  ],
  mcpServers: [
    {
      name: "neon",
      transport: {
        type: "streamable-http",
        url: neonServerUrl.toString(),
      },
    },
  ],
});

const neonAgentNetwork = createNetwork({
  name: "neon-agent",
  agents: [neonAgent],
  defaultModel: anthropic({
    model: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
    defaultParameters: {
      max_tokens: 1000,
    },
  }),
  router: ({ network }) => {
    if (!network?.state.kv.get("answer")) {
      return neonAgent;
    }
    return;
  },
});

// Create and start the server
const server = createServer({
  networks: [neonAgentNetwork],
});

server.listen(3010, () =>
  console.log("Support Agent demo server is running on port 3010")
);"><pre><span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>

        <span class="pl-s1">network</span><span class="pl-kos">?.</span><span class="pl-c1">state</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">kv</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">set</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"answer"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">answer</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
      <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">mcpServers</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-c1">name</span>: <span class="pl-s">"neon"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
      <span class="pl-c1">transport</span>: <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">type</span>: <span class="pl-s">"streamable-http"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">url</span>: <span class="pl-s1">neonServerUrl</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">toString</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
      <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">neonAgentNetwork</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">createNetwork</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">name</span>: <span class="pl-s">"neon-agent"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">agents</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s1">neonAgent</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">defaultModel</span>: <span class="pl-en">anthropic</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">model</span>: <span class="pl-s">"claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620"</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">defaultParameters</span>: <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-c1">max_tokens</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1000</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
  <span class="pl-en">router</span>: <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span> network <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">=></span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
    <span class="pl-k">if</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">!</span><span class="pl-s1">network</span><span class="pl-kos">?.</span><span class="pl-c1">state</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-c1">kv</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">get</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"answer"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
      <span class="pl-k">return</span> <span class="pl-s1">neonAgent</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
    <span class="pl-kos">}</span>
    <span class="pl-k">return</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
  <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Create and start the server</span>
<span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">server</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">createServer</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span>
  <span class="pl-c1">networks</span>: <span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s1">neonAgentNetwork</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span>
<span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-s1">server</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">listen</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">3010</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span> <span class="pl-c1">=></span>
  <span class="pl-smi">console</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">log</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s">"Support Agent demo server is running on port 3010"</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
<span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Deterministic Routing with State-based routing</h2><a id="user-content-deterministic-routing-with-state-based-routing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Deterministic Routing with State-based routing" href="#deterministic-routing-with-state-based-routing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">AgentKit provides a unique approach to deterministic Routing with State-based routing that enables the implementation of code-based to fully autonomous routing while keeping control all along the way.</p>
<p dir="auto">The State is a key value stored and shared between all the Agents of the same network.</p>
<p dir="auto">This state is then accessible from the router, agent lifecycle callbacks, agent prompts, and agent tools:</p>
